title: Efficient Reduced Free-Energy Computation for Atomistic Systems
exact_target: Compute the reduced free energy per removed atom efficiently as the number of removed atoms grows.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001271 (OWR-3479-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Computational Multiscale Methods (2009), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2009/29, pp. 1597--1666; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF page 26.

status_qualification: Efficiency and the allowed potentials are not quantitatively specified. The report describes a method for chain-like nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor systems even when atom coordinates are multidimensional. Its passage closely repeats ID 30001115; the latter clean formulation explicitly restricts to a one-dimensional system, so the potentially broader catalogue record is retained with this relation disclosed.
